name: moodle
title: Moodle
description: Access Moodle courses, download course files, track assignments, sync deadlines to Calendar, and read notifications. Supports Web Service tokens and browser MoodleSession cookies for SSO.
author: RJperson

commands.name: browse-courses
commands.title: Browse Courses and Files
commands.subtitle: Moodle
commands.description: Browse enrolled courses, sections, and download course documents, slides, and files.

commands.name: upcoming-assignments
commands.title: Upcoming Deadlines & Assignments
commands.subtitle: Moodle
commands.description: View upcoming assignment deadlines, submission status, and add directly to Apple Calendar.

commands.name: notifications
commands.title: Notifications & Announcements
commands.subtitle: Moodle
commands.description: View recent Moodle notifications, alerts, and course announcements.

commands.name: quick-links
commands.title: Quick Open Moodle
commands.subtitle: Moodle
commands.description: Quickly jump to Moodle Dashboard, My Courses, Calendar, or Grades in browser.

preferences.name: moodleUrl
preferences.title: Moodle URL
preferences.description: The base URL of your Moodle instance (e.g. https://moodle.your-university.edu)

preferences.name: apiToken
preferences.title: Token or MoodleSession Cookie
preferences.description: Your Moodle Web Service API token, or your browser MoodleSession cookie (for SSO logins).
preferences.placeholder: Enter token or paste MoodleSession cookie

preferences.name: downloadDirectory
preferences.title: Download Directory
preferences.description: Folder where downloaded course files are saved. Defaults to ~/Downloads if left blank.

preferences.name: calendarName
preferences.title: macOS Calendar Name
preferences.description: Name of the calendar to add events into (leave empty to use default calendar).
preferences.placeholder: e.g. School, Study, or leave empty
